title: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: Suppose the business school of your university is conducting a survey to collect students' opinions on the express delivery service industry in China. You are to write a response about its recent development and its impact on people's lives. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: As a student invited to share my views in this survey, I am glad to comment on the express delivery industry in China, which has grown at an astonishing pace in recent years. To begin with, the recent development of this industry is remarkable. Delivery networks now reach even remote villages, and parcels that once took a week can be delivered overnight. Smart lockers and automated sorting centres, powered by big data, have made the whole process faster and more accurate than ever before. More importantly, this development has reshaped our daily lives. With reliable next-day delivery, people can shop online for almost anything, from food to books, without leaving home. Such convenience saves us time and energy, and it has also created millions of jobs for delivery workers across the country. In conclusion, China's express delivery industry has advanced rapidly and brought real benefits to ordinary people. I firmly believe it will continue to make our lives even more convenient.
keyPoints: 开头即应景亮中心。本段用 As a student invited to share my views in this survey 呼应调 查情境、点明应答身份，再以 which has grown at an astonishing pace 的定语从句总起中心，落实了 首段『应邀点题加亮中心』的功能。
发展段有具体支撑。本段用 parcels that once took a week can be delivered overnight 做 今昔对比，又举 Smart lockers and automated sorting centres 的智能技术，把『发展』写得具体可 信，而非空喊『很发达』。
影响落到普通人。本段以 More importantly 递进到影响，用 people can shop online for almost anything 写个人便利，再以 created millions of jobs 补社会层面的就业影响，从个人到社会有 层次。
总评加展望收尾。本段用 In conclusion 合并发展与影响重申中心，再以 I firmly believe it will continue 表态展望收尾，干净呼应开头。
